questions.question: The average of ten numbers is 18.2. The average of the first four numbers is 16.6 and that of the last seven numbers is 20.8. If the 4th number is excluded, then the average of the remaining numbers is (correct to one decimal place):
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 10 numbers = 18.2

Average of first 4 numbers = 16.6 

Average of last 7 numbers = 20.8 

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of observations/No of observations

**Calculation:**

Average of 10 numbers = 18.2 

⇒ Sum of 10 numbers/10 = 18.2

questions.question: The total surface area of a solid right circular cylinder of height 13 cm, is 880 cm². Its volume (in cm³) is 11k, The value of k is: (take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total surface area of solid right circular cylinder = 880 cm2

Height of the right circular cylinder = 13 cm 

**Formulas used:**

Total surface area of a cylinder = 2πrh + 2πr²

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad73dbaaf925fea38524c2b9dd5814bba718006d60c8ede2aae37815e7ee5823.png] 

Total surface area of right circular cylinder = 880 cm²

⇒ 2πrh + 2πr2 = 880

⇒ 2πr(h + r) = 880 

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × r × (13 + r) = 880 

⇒ (13 + r)r = 880 × 7/22 × 1/2

⇒ 13r + r² = 140

⇒ r2 + 13r - 140 = 0

⇒ r2 + 20r - 7r - 140 = 0

⇒ r(r + 20) - 7(r + 20) = 0

⇒ (r - 7)(r + 20) = 0

⇒ r = 7, r ≠ 20

Volume of the right circular cylinder = 11k 

⇒ 22/7 × 7 × 7 × 13 = 11k 

⇒ 22/7 × 7 × 7 × 13 × 1/11 = k

⇒ k = 182 

**∴ The required value of k is 182.**

questions.question: The average of the 2-digit numbers 37, 45, 6x and x6 is 48. What is the average of (4x + 3) and (x + 7)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of numbers 37, 45, 6x and x6 = 48

**Formula used:**

Average of observations = Sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The numbers 6x and x6 can be written as 60 + x and 10x + 6 in terms of the sum of unit digit and ten's digit. 

Now, (37 + 45 + 60 + x + 10x + 6)/4 = 48 

⇒ 148 + 11x = 48 × 4 

⇒ 148 + 11x = 192

⇒ 11x = 192 - 148 

⇒ x = 44/11

⇒ x = 4

Average of (4x + 3) and (x + 7) = (4 × 4 + 3 + 4 + 7)/2

⇒ 30/2 

⇒ 15 

**∴ The required result is 15.**

questions.question: The ratio of the speeds of A and B is 2 : 5. To cover a certain distance, if A takes 15 minutes more than B, then how much time (in minutes) will B take to cover the same distance?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of speeds of A and B = 2 : 5

Time taken by A = Time taken by B + 15 minutes

**Formula used:**

Speed = 1/Time 

**Calculation:**

Ratio of speeds of A and B = 2 : 5

⇒ Ratio of time of A and B = 5 : 2

Let the time taken A and B be 5y and 2y respectively. 

As per the question, 

5y - 2y = 3y = 15 minutes

⇒ y = 5 

∴ Time taken by B to cover the same distance = 2y 

**⇒ 2 × 5 = 10 minutes**

questions.question: A person saves 28% of his income. If his income increases by 20% and the expenditure reduces by 5%, then his savings increase by x%. The value of x is closest to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of saving out of income = 28%

New income = Old income increased by 20%

New expenditure = Old expenditure decreased by 5%

**Formula used:**

Income = Saving + Expenditure

Percentage increase in Saving = (New Saving - Old Saving)/Old Saving × 100 

**Calculation:**

Let the income be 100. 

⇒ Saving = 100 × 28/100 = 28 

⇒ Expenditure = 100 - 28 = 72 

Increased income = 100 + 100 × 20/100 = 120 

Reduced expenditure = 72 × 95/100 = 68.4

⇒ New Saving = 120 - 68.4 = 51.6

Percentage increase in saving = x%

⇒ x% = (51.6 - 28)/28 × 100

⇒ 23.6/28 × 100 = 84.28%

**∴ The value of x (84.28) is closest to 84.5. **

questions.question: When x is subtracted from each of 24, 30, 36 and 46, the numbers so obtained in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (2x + 3) and (3x + 2)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If x is subtracted from each of 24, 30, 36, and 46, the numbers would in proportion. 

**Concepts used:**

Componendo and Dividendo

If p:q :: r:s, then 

Componendo

⇒ (p + q)/q = (r + s)/s

Dividendo

⇒ (p - q)/p = (r - s)/s

Mean Proportional between two numbers a and b = √ab

**Calculation:**

As per the question,

(24 - x)/(30 - x) = (36 - x)/(46 - x)

Using Componendo and Dividendo

⇒ (24 - x + 30 - x)/(24 - x - 30 + x) = (36 - x + 46 - x)/(36 - x - 46 + x)

⇒ (54 - 2x)/(- 6) = (82 - 2x)/(-10) 

⇒ (27 - x)/3 = (41 - x)/5

⇒ 5(27 - x) = 3(41 - x)

⇒ 135 - 5x = 123 - 3x 

⇒ 12 = 2x

⇒ x = 6

**∴ Mean proportional between (2x + 3) and (3x + 2) = √(2x + 3)(3x + 2)**

⇒ √(2 × 6 + 3)(3 × 6 + 2)

⇒ √300 

⇒ 10√3

questions.question: A sold an article to B at a loss of 20%, and B sold it to C at a profit of 32%. C sold it to D at a loss of 20%. If A’s loss is Rs. 35 less than that of C, then B bought the article for:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let the CP of A be 100 units.

SP of A = CP of B = 100 - 20 = 80 units

SP of B = CP of C = 80 × 1.32 = 105.6 units

SP of C = CP of D = 105.6 × 0.8 = 84.48 units

Loss of A = 20 units, Loss of C = 105.6 - 84.48 = 21.12 units

Difference in the loss = 21.12 - 20 = 1.12 units = 35

1 unit = 31.25

C.P of B = SP of A = 31.25 × 80 = Rs. 2500

**Traditional method:**

**Given:**

Loss incurred by A = 20%

Profit earned by B = 32%

Loss incurred by C = 20%

Loss of A = Loss of C - Rs.35 

**Formulas used:**

Profit or Loss both are calculated on the cost price incurred by the buyer. 

Loss = Cost Price - Selling Price 

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price

Selling Price at profit = Cost Price × (100 + Profit)%

Selling Price at Loss = Cost Price × (100 - Loss)%

**Calculation:**

Selling Price for A = Cost Price for B 

Selling Price for B = Cost Price for C 

Selling Price for C = Cost Price for D

Let the CP for A = 100a 

Selling Price for A = 100a × (100 - 20)% = Cost Price for B 

⇒ 80a

Selling Price for B = 80a × (100 + 32)% = Cost Price for C

⇒ 105.6a

Selling Price for C = 105.6a × (100 - 20)% = Cost Price for D

⇒ 84.48a

Loss of A = 100a - 80a = 20a 

Loss of C = 105.6a - 84.48a = 21.12a

As per the question

Loss of C - Loss of A = Rs.35 

Here, 1.12a = Rs.35 

∴ a = Rs.35/1.12 

Cost Price at which B bought the article = 80a 

⇒ 80a = 35/1.12 × 80

⇒ 80a = 2500 

**∴ The cost price at which B bought the article from A is Rs.2500 **

questions.question: There is a rectangular plot, 120 m long and 98 m wide, with semi-circular flower beds along the breadth on both sides of the plot. The cost of putting a fence all around the plot at Rs.16.50 per m is: (take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Measures of rectangular plot = 120 m × 98 m 

Cost of putting a fence around the plot = Rs.16.50 per m 

There are two semi-circular flower beds along the breadth of the plot. 

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of circle = 2πr 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/289e5b587ea72101df6a8b6dd379a100f5e9dcf0d9a0733213a510b2fdc239c9.png] 

In order to find out the cost of putting fence all around the plot, we will need to find the length of the whole plot. 

It can be written as = πr + L + L + πr 

⇒ 2πr + 2L 

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × 98/2 + 2 × 120 

⇒ 308 + 240 

⇒ 548 m 

Cost of fencing the plot = Length of the plot × Rate per m 

⇒ 548 × Rs.16.5 

⇒ Rs.9042 

**∴ The required sum is Rs.9042.**

questions.question: By selling an article for Rs. 820, Abhi loses 18%. To gain 25.5%, he should sell it for:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Loss = 18%

Required profit = 25.5%

The final selling price = 820 × (100/82) × (125.5/100)

= Rs. 1255

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price at 18% loss = Rs.820 

**Formulas used:**

Profit or Loss is calculated on Cost Price which is 100% of itself. 

Selling Price = Cost Price × (100 ± Proft/Loss)%

⇒ Cost Price = Selling Price/(100 ± Proft/Loss)%

**Calculation:**

Cost Price = 820/(100 - 18)%

⇒ Cost Price = Rs.1000

Selling Price at 25.5% profit = 1000 × (100 + 25.5)%

⇒ 1000 × 125.5/100 

⇒ Rs.1255

**∴ The required result is Rs.1255**

questions.question: What least number must be subtracted from 2963 so that the resulting number when divided by 9, 10 and 15, the remainder in each case is 5?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number = 2963 

**Concept used:**

Lowest Common Multiple

**Calculation:**

LCM of (9, 10, 15) = 3 × 3 × 10 

⇒ 90

2963/90, remainder = 83

∴ The least number that must be subtracted from 2963 which gives remainder 5 when divided by 9, 10 and 15:

**⇒ 83 - 5 = 78**

questions.question: The compound interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 15% per annum is Rs. 3,641, when the interest is compounded 8-monthly. The sum is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Compound interest for 2 years at 15% per annum = Rs.3641

**Formulas used:**

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal 

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Compounded 8-monthly rate = 15% × 8/12 = 10% per 8-month

Time = 24/8 = 3 periods

3641 = P × (1 + 10/100)³ - P 

⇒ 3641 = P × 1331/1000 - P 

⇒ 3641 = P × 331/1000

⇒ P = 3641 × 1000/331 

⇒ P = 11000

**∴ The required sum is Rs.11000.**

questions.question:
What is the mean of the median and the mode of the data:

19, 20, 14, 15, 19, 16, 17, 15,14, 13, 18, 19, 17, 13
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Data: 19, 20, 14, 15, 19, 16, 17, 15,14, 13, 18, 19, 17, 13

**Concepts used:**

Mean = Arithmetic average of the data. 

Mode = It is an observation that occurs highest number of times.

Median = It is the middle observation. 

**Calculation:**

By arranging the data in ascending order, we get

13, 13, 14, 14, 15, 15, 16, 17, 17, 18, 19, 19, 19, 20

Mode = 19 

Out of 14 observations, middle value will be the average of 7th and 8th value.

Median = (16 + 17)/2 = 16.5 

**∴ Mean of median and mode = (16.5 + 19)/2 = 17.75**

questions.question: A can do a certain work in 30 days. B is 25% more efficient than A, and C is 20% more efficient than B. A and B work together for 10 days. C alone completes the remaining work in x days. The value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A = 30 days 

Efficiency of B = 25% more than A

Efficiency of C = 20% more than B

**Formula used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time taken 

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of A be = 100 

⇒ Efficiency of B will be = 125

⇒ Efficiency of C will be = 150 

∴ Ratio of efficiencies of A, B and C is 100 : 125 : 150 respectively. 

⇒ A : B : C = 4 : 5 : 6 

Total Work = 4 × 30 = 120 units 

Work done by A and B in 10 days = (4 + 5) × 10 = 90 

⇒ Remaining work = 120 - 90 = 30 units 

C did the remaining work in x days, so x days = 30 units/6 

⇒ x days = 5 days 

**∴ The required result is 5 days. **

questions.question: The simple interest on a sum of Rs. 4,800 for 4(1)/(2) years at a certain rate per annum is Rs. 1,684.80, What will be the amount of the same sum at the same rate for 6 (2)/(3) years at simple interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest on Rs.4800 for 4(1)/(2) years = Rs.1684.80

**Formulas used:**

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate/100 × Time 

Amount = Principal + Simple interest 

**Calculation:**

Simple interest = 1684.80 

⇒ 4800 × 4(1)/(2) × Rate/100 = 1684.80 

⇒ Rate = 1684.80/(24 × 9)

⇒ Rate = 7.8%

Amount for 6 (2)/(3) years = Principal + Simple interest 

⇒ 4800 + 4800 × 6 (2)/(3) × 7.8%

⇒ 4800 + 4800 × 20/3 × 78/1000 

⇒ 4800 + 2496 

⇒ 7296 

**∴ The required amount = Rs.7296**

questions.question: A can do 33 (1)/(3) \% of a work in 10 days, and B can do 20% of the same work in 9 days. They worked together for 8 days. C alone completed 30% of the remaining work in 10 days. A and C together can do the same work in
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to do 33 (1)/(3) \% of a piece of work = 10 days 

Time taken by B to do 20% of the same work = 9 days 

**Formula used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time 

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be 1 unit. 

Time taken by A to do 100% of the work = 10 × 3 = 30 days 

Time taken by B to do 100% of the work = 9 × 5 = 45 days

One day work of A = 1/30 

⇒ Work done by A in 8 days = 8/30 

One day work of B = 1/45 

⇒ Work done by B in 8 days = 8/45 

Remaining work = (1 - 8/30 - 8/45)

⇒ (90 - 24 - 16)/90 = 50/90

30% of the remaining work to be done by C in 10 days. 

∴ One day work efficiency of C = (50/90 × 30/100)/10 = 1/6 

⇒ 1/60 

One day work efficiency of A and C = (1/30 + 1/60) = 1/20 

**∴ Time taken by A and C to do the same work = 1/(1/20) **

**⇒ 20 days **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** By LCM Method

Formula used:

Total Work = Efficiency × Time 

**Calculation:**

Let total work be the LCM of time taken by A and B to do the work. 

Time taken by A to do 100% of the work = 10 × 3 = 30 days 

Time taken by B to do 100% of the work = 9 × 5 = 45 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cde91175027a281074c2e9ac6aef0d3c8a306b8ffe2a40bd16e8a6fe4a67739a.png] 

Work done in 8 days = 8 × ( 3 + 2) = 40 

Remaining work = 90 - 40 = 50 

Work to be done by C in 10 days = 50 × 30/100 = 15 

⇒ One day efficiency of C = 15/10 = 1.5 

One day efficiency of A and C = (3 + 1.5) = 4.5 

**∴ Time taken by A and C to do the enitre work = 90/4.5 = 20 days **

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 2,560. During a sale, two successive discounts of 20% and x% are offered on it. If the selling price of the article is Rs. 1,679.36, then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price of the article = Rs.2560

Successive Discounts rates = 20% and x%

Selling Price of the article = Rs.1679.36 

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (100 - Discount)%

**Calculation:**

Rs.1679.36 = Rs.2560 × (100 - 20)% × (100 - x)% 

⇒ 1679.36 = 2560 × 80/100 × (100 - x)/100 

⇒ 167936/100 × 100/80 × 100/2560 = (100 - x)

⇒ 20992/256 = 100 - x

⇒ 82 = 100 - x 

**∴ x = 18 **

questions.question: A person can row 5 m/sec in still water. The speed of the stream is 6 km/h. The time (in hours) taken by him to row a distance of 76.8 km downstream is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the boat in still water = 5 m/sec

Speed of the stream = 6 km/h

Distance to be covered = 76.8 km 

**Formulas used:**

Speed downstream = Speed of the boat + Speed of the stream 

Time = Distance/Speed 

**Calculation:**

Speed of the boat in km/h = 5 m/sec × 18/5 

⇒ 18 km/h 

∴ Required time = 76.8/(18 + 6) 

⇒ 76.8/24 

**⇒ 3.2 hours**

questions.question: The monthly incomes of A and B are in the ratio 2 : 3, and the ratio of their savings is 3 : 4. If the income of A equals the savings of B, then the ratio of the expenditures of A and B is:
questions.solution:

Ratio of the incomes of A and B = 2 : 3 

Ratio of the savings of A and B = 3 : 4

Income of A = Savings of B

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings 

Income - Savings = Expenditure

**Calculation:**

 Let the income of A and B be 2x and 3x

And their savings be 3y and 4y

According to question

2x = 4y

Expenditure = Income - Savings 

Expenditure A: Expenditure B = (2x - 3y) : (3x - 4y)

Expenditure A: Expenditure B = (2x - 1.5x) : (3x - 2x)

Expenditure A: Expenditure B = 0.5 : 1 = 1 : 2
